title: spike-sessions WU-4.5: calibration gate (HARD GATE before WU-6)
description: Validate the 9 rubric scorers against operator-declared ground truth on 2 real sibling sessions. Operator picks 1 known-good + 1 known-drifted session, labels expected verdict for each of the 9 scorers (= 18 labels). Run scoreTimeline on both sessions; compare verdict-by-verdict. AGREEMENT RULE: for each scorer, ≥80% agreement across the 2 sessions (i.e. agreement on both, or 1-of-2 with explicit written justification) → KEEP. <80% → DROP: delete the scorer module, remove from RubricKey enum, decrement ProcessRubricScore.items.length, update design §7 table. Deliverable: docs/sessions-calibration.md recording per-criterion label/verdict/agreement/decision. If labels would reveal proprietary detail from sibling repos, commit only counts and decisions. HARD GATE: WU-6 cannot start until this closes. KILL SWITCH: if <6 of 9 scorers pass, escalate to operator per design §15.3 — do NOT auto-ship a degraded rubric.
notes: Calibration RAN 2026-05-17 (agent-judged per operator delegation). Outcome: §15.3 calibration kill — all 7 smoke-survey sessions score overall:fail; only 5/9 criteria survive §9.4 in spirit. Bead stays OPEN until the operator records a §15.3 decision. Full record: docs/sessions-calibration.md.

title: spike-sessions WU-3: JSONL parser
description: Implement packages/sessions/src/jsonl-reader.ts exporting parseTranscript(filePath, fs?) → SessionTimeline. Pure, fs injectable. title: Flaky test: beads-reader-default-executor times out under coverage instrumentation
description: packages/collector/src/__tests__/beads-reader-default-executor.test.ts ('invokes execFile against a non-existent bd ...') intermittently times out — observed 5007ms vs the 5000ms vitest default during 'npm run test:coverage'. The test does a REAL execFile against a non-existent bd; under v8 coverage instrumentation the spawn+timeout is too tight. Pre-existing (collector package, unrelated to sessions-spike v5). A re-run passes. Fix: raise the per-test timeout (e.g. 15000ms) or mock execFile so the test is deterministic.

title: metaswarm OOTB: external-tools cost ledger broken/unwired
description: metaswarm's external-tools cost tracking is designed but non-functional, found during sessions-spike v5 brainstorming. (1) The delegation ledger ~/.claude/sessions/external-tools.jsonl is never written. (2) plugin skills/external-tools/adapters/_common.sh extract_cost_codex() selects a top-level .usage key that codex-cli 0.130 no longer emits (token data moved to payload.type=token_count -> info.total_token_usage) so Codex delegations would always log 0 tokens. (3) bin/estimate-cost.sh (metaswarm scaffolding copied into the repo) is dead code, never called; no tokens->USD conversion is wired despite documented budget circuit-breakers. The v5 dashboard sidesteps this by reading ~/.codex/sessions/ directly. Action: report upstream to the metaswarm project.

title: CI: bump actions/checkout + setup-node to v5 before 2026-06-02
description: GitHub Actions deprecation: actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 run on Node.js 20, forced to Node 24 on 2026-06-02 and removed 2026-09-16. Bump both to @v5 in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Non-blocking warning today; trivial 2-line change.

title: spike-v4 follow-up: re-introduce the scope-drift rubric scorer
description: scope-drift was dropped in design v2 §7.1 — the active bead's declared file scope is not in bd output. Re-introduce as a 10th rubric criterion once 'bd show --json' exposes the declared file scope.

title: spike-v4 follow-up: harden dataDir-inside-git
description: v4-6 WARNS (filesystem ancestor .git walk) if the datalake sits inside a git working tree, but does not refuse the rating write. A future hardening could refuse, or guide the operator to relocate the datalake. See git-footgun.ts.

title: spike-v4 follow-up: cross-session aggregation / trend view
description: Rubric+rating score over time, side-by-side session compare. Out of v4 scope (design §2). CalibrationSummary already aggregates agreement; a trend/compare view is the next step. Conditional on the 2-week usage check passing.

title: spike-v4 follow-up: CLI subcommands (audit / timeline / tail)
description: v3 planned a CLI (audit/timeline/tail); v4 shipped the web /sessions view instead and deferred the CLI. audit/timeline overlap the web view; tail (terminal-pane live monitoring, v3 UC-2) is the distinctive verb — explicitly PARKED, not killed. Reconsider after the 2-week usage check. See docs/follow-ups/sessions.md.

title: Typed multi-source activity on dashboard project cards
description: Today ProjectSummary.lastActivityAt is computed only from BEADS task closed_at/updated_at (collector/src/metrics.ts), so projects with recent git commits but no beads tasks render 'Never' — misleading. Add typed per-source activity (git last commit, beads, claude-code sessions) with a source badge on the card and a click-through detail drawer showing per-source breakdown. Claude/agent activity must CONSUME the sessions-spike output (packages/sessions) — not re-implement transcript reading. DEFERRED: start only after the spike-sessions WUs land. Process when picked up: /brainstorm -> design review gate -> plan. Scope: packages/collector, types, server, web.
